title: Analytics Engineer (Contract)
description:
Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.
 Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.
 For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.
 Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.
 We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.
 Today, Lemrock is already:
 100M+ conversations per month
 150+ brand clients
 a $100B market structuring at high speed
 The role We are accelerating. The product works, clients renew, the market is taking shape. Every day, shoppers talk to AI agents before they buy, and performance has been at the heart of how we build the product from day one. We now want to go further and faster: understand precisely what makes our campaigns and recommendations perform, and apply it to the product continuously.
 As our freelance Analytics Engineer, full-time, you will dig into our data to find what drives performance, then turn your findings into changes in the product. You will work directly with the founders and the product and engineering teams.
 Understand what drives performance Explore every data source we have: conversations, web and behavioural events, campaign performance, product and advertiser metadata
 Find what drives performance and size the impact of each lever
 Measure every change with A/B tests, and feed the results back into the next analysis
 Turn findings into changes Apply what you find to the product yourself, with Claude Code: which products we prioritise, who we show them to, how we present them
 Write and maintain the Claude Code skills that make these updates repeatable, reviewed by the engineering team

title: Manager - Tax Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing Tax Data Mart team. This role will be a key contributor to the team and will be responsible for building the tax data operations function for our Deliveroo and Wolt legal entities.  This includes building and operating the data pipelines and infrastructure that power tax analytics and support decision-making across the company.

As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with experience working with Tax teams to gather requirements, and designing scalable data processes to support them.. This person will grow our unique community via your blend of tax, data technology, and process improvement experience.

About the Role

You will be reporting to the Senior Manager of Tax Data & Operations, and play an integral role in DoorDash’s data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users.

As a member of this team, you will lead the…

title: Head of Data Engineering
description:
Our Company
 At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.
 Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.
 We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.
 With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.
 The Role
 Our Data Engineering team is growing! We're looking for a Head of Data Engineering to join our team in London.
 In this role you will lead the data engineering team that powers the Quantum Platform, own the technical strategy and delivery roadmap for our data infrastructure, and turn business ambition into intelligence that scales.
 Key Responsibilities
 Build, lead and develop a high-performing data engineering team, recruiting and retaining engineers who take pride in what they ship and how it performs
 Set and own the data engineering technical strategy, so our data infrastructure scales with the business
 Lead the delivery roadmap, meeting business objectives and making well-reasoned trade-offs where they are needed
 Partner with product, marketing, commercial and executive leadership to shape data priorities that move business performance
 Set the technical bar and drive adoption of AI-led development across the function, staying close to the code where it counts
 About You
 Proven experience leading and developing data engineering teams, setting direction and building capability
 A track record of delivering data platforms that drove real customer and business results
 Hands-on technical credibility: you enjoy getting into the deta…

title: Senior Data Engineer - Real time analytics
description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.
 Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.
 Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
 How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.
 We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack.
 As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports.

title: Data Engineer - Senior Consultant
location: Hybrid - Newcastle, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, London
description:
Ready to build data platforms, not just pipelines?
 At Opencast, we believe great data engineering is about more than moving and transforming data. It's about creating reliable, scalable foundations that help organisations make better decisions and deliver better services.
 Our consultants tackle complex engineering challenges across integration, migration, modelling and platform design, working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure and modern data technologies. We value engineering craft, thoughtful problem-solving and building solutions that are simple, robust and built to last.
 As our data engineering capability continues to grow, you'll have the opportunity to influence its direction through delivery, mentoring, recruitment and technical leadership. If you're looking for a role where you can shape both solutions and the capability around them, we'd love to hear from you.
 The role
 Opencast data engineers help organisations transform how they manage, use and learn from data. The work ranges from building modern lakehouse and warehouse platforms in Microsoft Fabric to modernising legacy environments, migrating complex workloads and improving the quality, governance and reliability of critical data services.
 This role offers the opportunity to work across the full data lifecycle, combining platform design, engineering, integration and optimisation. Expect to work with structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, building batch and near real-time data pipelines that underpin critical business and public services.
 You'll collaborate with architects, analysts, software engineers and client teams to solve complex challenges and influence technical direction. The role also offers opportunities to contribute beyond delivery through mentoring, recruitment, community building and helping to define engineering standards and best practice as our capability continues to grow.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)
description:
Für unseren Kunden, ein Versicherungsunternehmen im Großraum Frankfurt am Main, suchen wir im Rahmen des Aufbaus einer neuen dispositiven Datenplattform (Lakehouse) auf Basis von Microsoft Azure und Databricks zwei erfahrene Data Engineers. Du baust die Datenstrecken von den Quellsystemen bis in das Core-Modell und übernimmst dabei die technische Federführung in der Umsetzung. Du arbeitest im Tandem mit Mitarbeitenden des Kunden und gibst dein Databricks-Know-how aktiv weiter.
 Aufgaben
 Anbindung von Quellsystemen und externen Dienstleistern (Delta-Lieferungen, Dateien, APIs) sowie eines CRM-Systems inklusive automatisierter Ladeprozesse
 Entwicklung von ETL/ELT-Strecken mit Delta-Verarbeitung, Fehlerbehandlung und nachvollziehbaren Wiederanlaufverfahren
 Umsetzung der Dublettenbereinigung und Zusammenführung von Kunden- und Vermittlerdaten
 Implementierung des Core-Datenmodells mit Historisierung entlang der Medallion-Architektur (Databricks, PySpark, SQL)
 Umsetzung von Datenqualitätsregeln, Prüfroutinen, Monitoring und Alerting
 Bereitstellung von Exporten und Rückflüssen an operative Systeme (z. B. Kampagnenselektionen für das CRM)
 Mitarbeit an Entwicklungspipeline und CI/CD, Rollen und Berechtigungen, Data Catalog und Lineage
 Dokumentation, Runbooks und Wissenstransfer im Tandem mit dem Kundenteam
 Anforderungen
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Data Engineer, idealerweise im Aufbau von Data-Warehouse- oder Lakehouse-Lösungen
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Databricks, PySpark/Spark, SQL und Delta Lake
 Praxis mit Databricks Workflows bzw. Azure Data Factory und weiteren Azure-Datenservices
 Erfahrung in Datenmodellierung und Historisierung (Data Vault und/oder dimensionale Modellierung)
 Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD und automatisiertem Testing von Datenpipelines
 Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Coding-Assistenten, agentische Workflows) von Vorteil
 Erfahrung mit Quellsystemen und Daten im Versicherungsumfeld von Vorteil
 Freude an Wissensvermittlung und Zusam…

title: AI First Data Engineer
description:
Was erwartet dich bei uns? Weiterbildung ab Tag 1 : Wir unterstützen dich zeitlich und finanziell bei deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung. Starke Unternehmenskultur : Offene Kommunikation, Hilfsbereitschaft, authentische Zusammenarbeit und ein echtes Learn-it-all-Mindset. New Work leben : Flexible Arbeitsorte, Workation in Europa und kultureller Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Spanien. Teamspirit : Arbeite mit Menschen, die motiviert sind, gemeinsam voranzukommen – und voneinander lernen wollen. Gestaltungsspielraum : Bei uns kannst du aktiv mitgestalten und echten Mehrwert für Kundschaft und Team schaffen. Top Arbeitsumgebung : Modern ausgestattete Büros, unter anderem im Circle am Flughafen Zürich, im PostParc in Bern und an bester Lage in Basel.
 Einführung Liegt deine Leidenschaft darin, mit AI echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen und moderne Data- & AI-Lösungen nicht nur zu entwickeln, sondern gemeinsam mit deinem AI-Agententeam erfolgreich in die Produktion zu bringen?
 Verbindest du technisches Know-how mit Eigenverantwortung, Kundenverständnis und einem echten AI-first Mindset? Denkst du gerne einen Schritt weiter, übernimmst die Führung und hast Freude daran, mit spezialisierten AI-Agenten neue Wege zu gehen?
 Dann gehörst du in unser Team! Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach mit AI – du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie wir als Unternehmen und für unsere Kunden arbeiten. Du gibst deinem AI-Agententeam die Richtung vor, verteilst Aufgaben, triffst Entscheidungen und verantwortest das Ergebnis. Dabei kombinierst du deine Expertise mit spezialisierten Agenten und entwickelst unsere Agenten und Workflows laufend weiter.
 Dafür stehst du am Morgen auf: Du baust Datenpipelines und Datenmodelle mit Databricks oder Microsoft Fabric auf Azure auf und schaffst damit die Grundlage für moderne AI- und Analytics-Lösungen.  Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

 Develop and document practical instrumentation and experimentation standards, then partner with product engineering teams to apply them to priority product development work.

 Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
 AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 Build data pipelines: Create and maintain batch and real-time pipelines that move data across Qonto's platform.
